CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a 180-degree orbit sweeping camera-right on a 100mm macro, framing with a tight crop that breaks the subject at the frame edge.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.
